title: Here is how i made over 200d profit crafting rings (PoE2 0.5 step by step guide)
creator: Fre drik

base.name: Gold Ring

otherMods: unfractured T1 rarity suffix (at least 18% rarity), at most four mods, item level 75 or higher; he fractures it himself. Pre-fractured rings are the alternative (4:53–5:20).

base.quote: I'm looking for at least 18 rarity with a maximum of four modifiers and an item level of at least 75.

steps.quote: using essence of the breach to get 40% attack modifier quality.

target.text: tier three flat damage or tier one rarity

steps.quote: When we chaos spam, we are looking for either tier three flat damage or tier one rarity.
steps.note: T3 applies to the flat, T1 to rarity. Chaos spam happens after the quality is done.

target.text: tier one rarity or tier two flat damage (whichever the chaos spam did not give)

steps.quote: you will greater exalt prefix and hope for either tier one rarity or tier two flat damage mod.
steps.note: After a T1 rarity from chaos he hopes for a T2 flat (0:39–0:44).

steps.quote: The next step is to desecrate a prefix with an ancient collarbone.

target.text: another flat damage modifier (T1 rarity or a good flat is acceptable in the second craft)

steps.quote: Now we will reroll this with omen of light until we hit another flat damage modifier.
steps.note: Reveal reroll; he got a T2 flat on the first craft (1:32–1:35).

target.text: attack speed, plus mana leech or a resistance

steps.quote: We will now try to get attack speed on the suffix. We can do this by slamming a suffix
steps.note: Exalt type is not stated for the first craft; the second craft uses a greater exalt on the suffix (3:24–3:30).

target.text: remove the slammed suffix and replace it with attack speed

steps.quote: removing that suffix with the use of omen of dextral crystallization in combination with a swift alloy.
steps.note: Swift Alloy is called the attack speed alloy later (3:40–3:43); removal is a 50/50 between the two suffixes.

missHandling.trigger: greater exalt misses (no T1 rarity or T2 flat)
missHandling.quote: If your greater exalt misses, then you will annul and try again.
missHandling.note: Orb of Annulment (catalog id annul), then greater exalt again.

missHandling.trigger: second suffix slam misses or the attack speed suffix was removed
missHandling.quote: If the second exalt misses, then we will have to use omen of dextral annulment to remove one of our suffixes.
missHandling.note: Omen of Dextral Annulment (omen-of-dextral-annulment); then slam a new suffix and repeat until attack speed plus one solid suffix.

qualityPath.orderNote: 40% attack-modifier quality comes from Essence of the Breach, applied first, before any chaos spam.

caveats: Main flow (4:11–4:21): he buys UNfractured gold rings with the T1 rarity suffix and fractures them himself; buying pre-fractured rings is the alternative (4:53). For a pre-fractured ring the fractured mod must not be a prefix and must not be a crafted (essence) mod, because a crafted fractured mod blocks the crafts (5:09–5:20). One crafted mod fits on an item, so the Breach essence mod has to be gone before the Swift Alloy goes on (inferred from the one-crafted-mod rule, KB §7; fracturing a crafted mod uses the slot up for good).
Trade search filter given: at least 18 rarity, at most 4 modifiers, item level at least 75, no crafted modifiers, no corrupted (4:11–4:35).
Breach rings work as an alternative base (4:24–4:28).
Second craft accepts either T1 rarity or a good flat for the last prefix (3:15–3:20) and settles for mana leech or resistance on the suffix (3:24–3:35).
unresolved: Title claims over 200d profit; the transcript states no cost, sale price, attempt count or success rate.
Exalt type for the suffix slam in the first craft (1:47) is not stated.
Number of chaos spins and fracture attempts per ring is not stated.
The fracture itself is not shown and no odds are stated; the video starts from a fractured ring.
